newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Dunaferr, Samsung sign supply agreement.
newsitem.headline: Dunaferr, Samsung sign supply agreement.

text.p: Hungarian steel group Dunaferr Rt and Korea's Samsung signed a supply agreement on Tuesday following a recent contract between the Korean Eximbank and the National Bank of Hungary which cleared the last obstacle to the contract.

"Dunaferr Group may use the $25 million loan for a hot rolling mill downcoiler project the main contractor for which is Samsung and Hyundai is amongst its subcontractors," Dunaferr and Samsung said in a press release.

"This is a development which will further widen Dunaferr's product range and will greatly help its business results," Istvan Horvath, Dunaferr's chairman and general director said on the occasion of the signing ceremony.
The project will boost profits annually by 510 million forints, the two contractors said in the statement. Costs are to be recovered within six years.
The loan is provided for 20 years with a five-year grace period and bears a preferential interest rate which was not disclosed.

To implement the project the Korean government has provided a $50 million preferential framework credit agreement for Hungary. Applications could be submitted to Hungary's ministry of industry and trade, the statement said.

Dunaferr applied for $28 million and received $25 million with the guarantee of the Hungarian government. The project cost and the remaining balance of the extra cost will be financed by Dunaferr's own resources.
